subject: Central Asian Cultural Night - Tuesday 6pm
text:
Assalomu alaykum, salem, salam!

Join us for Central Asian Cultural Night on Tuesday, October 20 at 6pm. Live dombra music, traditional food, and games. Everyone is welcome, no Central Asian connection required.

Come hungry.

CASA board
